call_points.text: IEX describes itself as an asset-light, high-margin platform with strong cash flows for organic and inorganic growth.

call_points.text: Grid India itself flagged scope, software robustness, single-point-of-failure and inter-exchange settlement issues in its comments on the draft PMR.

Clearing and settlement separation not required; registration under the PSS Act is procedural with no financial impact.
